pages.text: $(l)Hold use$() to scan whatever it points at - a block or creature up to 16 blocks away; a ring of starlight fills around your sight. Pointed at the open sky it reads starlight, moon and biome - or the structure you stand in - and hums towards fallen stars.$(br2)Held or $(l)worn on the head$(), its lens names what you look at, its alignments and whether you have $(l)researched$() it yet.
